header: THE CLEAN ANSWER FIRST for a health check-up lookup of ONE person (step 61a): "when is the health check-up of ticket 266288?" gives the date (or the dates), big and bold, above the row; "which department is ticket 228757 in for the January 2026 health check-up?" gives the department. I compute it from the rows the SQL returned (never with the model), and only when ALL the rows are about one ticket (or one name) and the question plainly asks WHEN or WHICH DEPARTMENT. A list ("who has the health check-up on 5 January 2026") keeps its count; anything else gets no headline.

symbols.name: formatCheckupDate
symbols.sig: export function formatCheckupDate(v: unknown): string | null
doc: Turns 2026-01-05 (or a Date) into "05 Jan 2026". Anything that is not a date gives null.
